learning_outcomes.text: Learns types and characteristics of heat exchangers.
Learns methods of heat exchanger analysis.
Calculates pressure loss and pumping power in heat exchangers.
Learns how the fouling effects the design and operational characteristics.
Designs different types of heat exchangers.

syllabus_topics: Classification of Heat Exchangers and Determination of Design Groups
Basic Design Methods of Heat Exchangers
Basic Design Methods of Heat Exchangers
Pressure Loss and Pumping Power in Heat Exchangers
Heat Exchanger Pressure Drop and Pumping Power
Fouling in Heat Exchangers and its effects
Shell and tube type heat exchanger and Design interim reports
Shell and tube type heat exchanger
Evaporator, Cooling tower, Condenser, and other heat exchangers.
bibliography: Fundamentals of Heat Exchanger Design, Ramesh K. Shah and Dusan P. Sekulic
Kakaç, S. ve Liu, H.,Heat Exchangers: Selection, Rating and Thermal Design, CRC Press LLC.
